### **User description** ## Summary This PR redesigns the Redis data migration tooling with significant improvements to user experience, functionality, and operational flexibility. The changes replace the basic `migrate-redis-data` command with a comprehensive `consolidate-redis-models` tool that provides multiple execution modes including manual CLI command generation. ### Key Changes - **Renamed command**: `migrate-redis-data` → `consolidate-redis-models` to better reflect its purpose of consolidating data to database 0 - **Enhanced Redis key migrator**: Replaced simple `Familia::Tools.move_keys` with intelligent `RedisKeyMigrator` that automatically selects optimal strategies (MOVE, MIGRATE, or dump/restore) - **Manual execution mode**: Added `--show-commands` option to generate redis-cli commands for manual execution, useful for production environments or when automation isn't preferred - **Improved batch processing**: Configurable batch sizes with safety limits (default: 100, max: 10,000) - **Better error handling**: Comprehensive error reporting with detailed statistics and recovery information - **Enhanced detection**: Migration mode now finds ALL data not in database 0, not just unexpected locations ### User Experience Improvements The new tool provides much clearer feedback and more control options: - **Progress tracking**: Real-time progress updates during migration with detailed statistics - **Dry run by default**: Safe preview mode prevents accidental data operations - **Multiple confirmation modes**: Interactive prompts, auto-confirm (`--yes`), and TTY detection - **Comprehensive help**: Built-in `--help` with examples and detailed option explanations - **Strategy transparency**: Shows which migration strategy will be used and provides equivalent CLI commands ### Operational Benefits - **Production-ready**: Manual command generation allows review and staged execution in sensitive environments - **Monitoring-friendly**: Detailed progress reporting and statistics collection - **Recovery-oriented**: Copy-first approach with verification steps before cleanup - **Documentation**: Added comprehensive Redis debugging documentation ### Technical Architecture The new implementation uses a proper migrator class that: - Analyzes key distribution and selects optimal migration strategies - Provides both automated and manual execution paths - Includes comprehensive error handling and rollback capabilities - Supports different Redis deployment scenarios (standalone, cluster, etc.) This redesign transforms a basic data movement tool into a production-ready migration system suitable for both development and production environments. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code) Co-Authored-By: Claude ___ ### **PR Type** Enhancement ___ ### **Description** - Redesigned Redis data migration command with enhanced UX - Added intelligent Redis key migrator with strategy selection - Implemented manual CLI command generation for production use - Enhanced legacy data detection for migration mode ___ ### Diagram Walkthrough ```mermaid flowchart LR A["migrate-redis-data"] --> B["consolidate-redis-models"] B --> C["RedisKeyMigrator"] C --> D["Strategy Selection"] D --> E["DUMP/RESTORE"] D --> F["MIGRATE"] C --> G["CLI Commands"] G --> H["Manual Execution"] ```
